g.title: HR_SESSIONOUTLINE
g.text: Session Content - This entity contains the session content / activities.
The identifier of the Session record.
The identifier of the Course Content record.
This field contains the concatenation of Session Code, Course Code and Session Outline Code
This is the name of the Activity for a session.
The catalogue of Resources used by the Session Activity
The identifier of the test record.
Indicates whether the completion of the activity is required to continue with the next activity.
Indicates that the session activity is scored.
Indicates that the session Activity is time constrained.
This flag determines if the content associated to the activity can be re-opened/viewed even when the activity has been completed.
The validity start date for an historical situation.
The validity end date for an historical situation.
The validity start date for an historical situation (UTC).
The validity end date for an historical situation (UTC).
Indicates the maximum number of attempts.
Indicates the minimum percentage required to pass.
Indicates an URL to join a webinar.
Indicates the subject of a session activity.
Indicates the identifier of the workflow instance used to execute the associated quiz.
Indicates the ranking of the session activity.
The identifier, on Office 365, of the user that scheduled the meeting.
This is the start date of an online meeting scheduled on teams by using Office 365
This is the end date of an online meeting scheduled on teams by using Office 365

g.title: HR_SESSION
g.text: Session - This entity contains training session.
The identifier of the Course record.
Training plan identifier related to Training Session.
This field contains the concatenation of Session Code and Course Code
The validity start date for an historical situation.
The validity end date for an historical situation.
Option to determine if an employee can self enrol or is subject to approval.
Minumum number of seats for the session.
Maximum number of seats for the session.
Indicates if a waiting list is allowed for the session.
Indicates the deadline policy for completing the course.
Number of days in which to complete the course.
The identifier of instructor evaluation survey.
With this field you can specify the criteria to determine if a course is passed.
This is the minimum score in percentage that determines the course has been passed.

description of field training classroom for entity session

Indicates the minimum required session attendance, expressed as a percentage. If the average of the overall activity attendances is less than this indicator, the whole session will be considered as Not Attended.
Activate this flag to mark this Training resource as required for compulsory training. For example, to renew or take a certification/qualification.
Number of days before the session starts you would like to send an automatic invitation by eMail.
Number of days after the attendance you would like to create the effectiveness evaluation.

g.title: HR_LEARNERACTIVITIES
g.text: Learner Activities - This entity is child of a Learner and details all learning activities for an enrolled Learner.
This field contains the code of learner activity.
This field contains the description of learner activity.
On an individual learning activity, this is the reference to the activity defined at session content level.
This is the completion status of a single Learning activity.
This flag states that the activity cannot be launched because previous activities have not yet been completed.
The date and time when the activity started.
The date and time when the activity ended.
This flag states if an activity has been completed successfully.
This is the numeric score achieved for the learning activity.
Number of attempts for a test.
Sort order that gives the sequence of activities for a course session.
Total absences taken for a single activity, if applicable.
Unit of measure for the total absences registered on a single activity, if applicable.
External Identifier to link the Activity with an external tool.
Date time when the external activity was taken for the last time.
Total time taken so far for the Activity.
This field includes a machine readable full log of the Learner Activity.
Displays the learner's progress for a specific Activity of a session.
